mathematical_meaning: A quasiparticle is an effective collective excitation.
input_role: Represent learned reusable collective features.
model_role: Motivate emergent skill or mode abstractions.
output_or_test: Test whether the abstraction predicts new cases.
limit: A learned feature is not automatically a physical quasiparticle.

mathematical_meaning: Band structure uses periodicity and spectral organization.
input_role: Encode periodic materials or repeated spatial structure.
model_role: Use Fourier/block-diagonal computation where valid.
limit: Arbitrary token sequences are not periodic crystals.

mathematical_meaning: Collective phases are many-body regimes.
input_role: Supply domain data across phase boundaries.
model_role: Test correlated world models and order parameters.
output_or_test: Measure actual predictive behavior across regimes.
limit: A sudden training gain is not evidence of a physical phase transition.

mathematical_meaning: Topological response can depend on global structure.
input_role: Encode loop and global relational tasks.
model_role: Explore topology-aware features and domain modules.
limit: Not every robust neural representation has a topological invariant.

mathematical_meaning: Anyons generalize exchange behavior in appropriate settings.
input_role: Use specialized physical tasks or braid representations.
model_role: Explore algebraically defined sequence operators.
output_or_test: Check braid relations and empirical utility.
limit: Anyons are not generic software particles or a guaranteed route to intelligence.

mathematical_meaning: A reduced description retains selected information.
input_role: Choose task-relevant features and marginals.
model_role: Compress state with a declared loss criterion.
output_or_test: Compare answers before and after reduction.
limit: A reduction can erase exactly the information a future task needs.

mathematical_meaning: Ehrenfest equations relate expectation dynamics to commutators.
input_role: Provide mean-observable trajectories.
model_role: Build moment-based approximate world models.
output_or_test: Check whether higher moments are needed.
limit: The mean equations need not form a closed classical system.

mathematical_meaning: A narrow wavepacket can justify local approximations.
input_role: Recognize concentrated input distributions.
model_role: Use local linearization or mode approximations.
limit: Concentration must be measured, not assumed.

mathematical_meaning: WKB is an asymptotic wave approximation.
input_role: Identify scale-separated physical data.
model_role: Accelerate a suitable scientific solver.
output_or_test: Test turning-point failures and regime bounds.
limit: It is not a universal shortcut for arbitrary neural inference.

mathematical_meaning: A Wigner function is a phase-space representation.
input_role: Encode conjugate-coordinate information.
model_role: Explore phase-space models of small systems.
limit: It may be negative and is not an ordinary probability density.

mathematical_meaning: Classical Liouville flow transports a phase-space density.
input_role: Use classical dynamical observations.
model_role: Provide a baseline world model or distribution transport.
output_or_test: Compare with quantum corrections where relevant.
limit: Classical and quantum flow are not generally identical.

mathematical_meaning: A Gibbs state weights energies by temperature.
input_role: Encode an energy-based hypothesis distribution.
model_role: Use probabilistic selection or equilibrium modeling.
output_or_test: Check partition normalization and temperature dependence.
limit: A learned energy must be connected to the task objective.

mathematical_meaning: Entropy summarizes a distribution or state spectrum.
input_role: Measure uncertainty under a specified interpretation.
model_role: Regularize diversity or diagnose collapse.
output_or_test: Compare entropy with calibration and useful learning.
limit: High entropy is not ignorance in every semantic sense, and low entropy is not correctness.

mathematical_meaning: Coarse graining discards distinctions at a chosen scale.
input_role: Aggregate tokens, patches or physical variables.
model_role: Build adaptive multiscale state.
output_or_test: Measure information and task loss after compression.
limit: Discarding distinctions can change future learning ability.

mathematical_meaning: The measurement problem concerns interpretation of outcomes.
input_role: Label unresolved foundational assumptions honestly.
model_role: Keep interpretation separate from executable update rules.
output_or_test: Avoid using an interpretation as performance evidence.
limit: No solution to this foundational question is claimed by an AI architecture.

mathematical_meaning: No cloning constrains unknown physical quantum states.
input_role: Account for physical data-copy limits.
model_role: Distinguish hardware registers from stored classical descriptions.
output_or_test: Check that hardware procedures do not assume free clones.
limit: Classical arrays and known state-preparation programs can be copied.

mathematical_meaning: Bell correlations test joint quantum predictions under assumptions.
input_role: Use proper scientific correlation data.
model_role: Validate specialized quantum models and entanglement tests.
limit: Bell violation does not establish AGI or permit signalling.

mathematical_meaning: No signalling constrains remote marginal changes.
input_role: Define permitted causal information flow.
model_role: Check physical communication claims.
output_or_test: Compare marginals under local trace-preserving maps.
limit: It does not imply that classical parallel modules communicate for free.

mathematical_meaning: Tomography estimates a state from measurement data.
input_role: Convert repeated physical measurements into an estimate.
model_role: Calibrate small state models.
limit: A single measurement does not reveal a full unknown state.

mathematical_meaning: Error correction uses redundancy to protect information.
input_role: Model actual noise and error syndromes.
model_role: Explore robust encodings or a hardware QEC layer.
output_or_test: Test failures at declared noise levels.
limit: Quantum error correction is not a free cure for model reasoning errors.

mathematical_meaning: An interferometer probes relative phase.
input_role: Generate phase-sensitive sensor tasks.
model_role: Test coherent encoders and readouts.
limit: An interference image alone does not show useful learning.

mathematical_meaning: A spin analyzer implements a spin measurement.
input_role: Define preparation and measurement axes.
model_role: Validate local state and effect components.
limit: Axis metadata is necessary to interpret the result.

mathematical_meaning: Spectroscopy probes energy differences and transitions.
input_role: Supply scientific measurements with uncertainties.
model_role: Train inverse or forward domain models.
output_or_test: Validate predicted spectra on unseen conditions.
limit: A spectral match may not uniquely identify the underlying model.

mathematical_meaning: A scattering experiment tests process predictions.
input_role: Encode beams, targets and detector geometry.
model_role: Use a specialized scientific world model.
output_or_test: Compare cross sections and error bars.
limit: It is a domain task, not a generic input-output learning law.

mathematical_meaning: Statistical validation qualifies empirical evidence.
input_role: Keep support, validation and test data separate.
model_role: Gate learning and model promotion.
output_or_test: Report seeds, uncertainty, baselines and failures.
limit: Adaptive reuse of a holdout can invalidate a simple confidence claim.

mathematical_meaning: A dense statevector stores all finite amplitudes.
input_role: Use small exact reference states.
model_role: Provide an oracle implementation for comparisons.
limit: Storage grows exponentially in qubit count.

mathematical_meaning: A dense density matrix stores a general finite mixed state.
input_role: Represent small correlated evidence exactly.
model_role: Validate reduced and approximate models.
output_or_test: Track trace, eigenvalues and temporary registers.
limit: Its cost grows as four to the number of qubits.

mathematical_meaning: A tensor network factorizes a structured state or operator.
input_role: Encode ordered or hierarchical dependencies.
model_role: Compress and contract controlled correlations.
output_or_test: Track bond dimensions and discarded information.
limit: Efficient simulation depends on structure, not on the notation alone.

mathematical_meaning: A finite cutoff bounds an otherwise larger space.
input_role: Limit grids, particle counts or sequence supports.
model_role: Make an explicit computable approximation.
output_or_test: Increase the cutoff and test convergence.
limit: A finite basis does not enumerate every possible quantum state.

mathematical_meaning: Trotter splitting approximates ordered evolution.
input_role: Use decomposable controlled generators.
model_role: Build sequences of cheap local updates.
output_or_test: Refine step size and measure error.
limit: Noncommuting terms produce a real approximation error.

mathematical_meaning: Physical invariants provide numerical checks.
input_role: Generate valid reference inputs.
model_role: Monitor structure-preserving operations.
output_or_test: Fail tests on trace, norm, positivity or conservation drift.
limit: Passing invariants does not establish intelligence or generalization.

mathematical_meaning: State preparation and readout consume resources.
input_role: Count conversion from original data and desired outputs.
model_role: Include encoders, measurements and decoding in benchmarks.
limit: A small core is not a small complete system if its interfaces are huge.

mathematical_meaning: Quantum-inspired computation runs selected mathematics classically.
input_role: Use classical data and arrays.
model_role: Explore structured complex, probabilistic and tensor mechanisms.
limit: Quantum-inspired is not evidence of a quantum hardware speedup.

mathematical_meaning: Open boundaries identify assumptions and unresolved results.
input_role: State what evidence and theory are missing.
model_role: Generate explicit next experiments and alternative constructions.
limit: An open question is a research target, not a guarantee or a reason to abandon useful attempts.
